detail.longDescription: Jev is a small model that answers one question at a time: yes or no, a pick from a list, or a score. ClawCast 12 covered it on October 1, and it plugs into OpenClaw from version 2026.9.6 in five steps. 8 jobs OpenClaw owners give it, from inbox sorting to spam checks: https:// oneclickclaw.io/news/jev-openc law-owners-8-jobs?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=jev-openclaw-owners-8-jobs&utm_content=day0 # OpenClaw # AIagents # SelfHosted # LLM Drafted with AI help, reviewed by the OneClickClaw team.
